description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 scores for several models across different datasets. The horizontal axis represents the dataset, with categories labeled SMD, PSM, SwaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, presented in that order. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%), with a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Four sets of bars are displayed for each dataset, representing the models MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (dark gray), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (red). For the SMD dataset, the MADLLM bar reaches approximately 97%, the MADLLM w/o prompt pool bar reaches approximately 94%, the MADLLM w/o feature embedding bar reaches approximately 95%, and the MADLLM w/o skip embedding bar reaches approximately 72%.  The WADI dataset shows the shortest bars, with MADLLM at approximately 75%, MADLLM w/o prompt pool at approximately 73%, MADLLM w/o feature embedding at approximately 74%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding at approximately 68%. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing one bar for each of the four models. No bars are visually emphasized, and the datasets are presented in a fixed, non-sorted order.
